$comment: FIXTURE: definitions live in NON-STANDARD containers (`custom-defs`, `even-more-custom-defs`) instead of `$defs`. The entry refs into `custom-defs`, which in turn refs into `even-more-custom-defs`. Both containers must be traversed by the ref-rewriter and the tree-shaker; the reached defs are kept, the unreferenced siblings are dropped, the containers are hollowed, and the body of this module is dropped.
title: Used custom defs
description: A module whose definitions live in non-standard containers.

body.$comment: Lives in the dropped body -> this ref must NOT make `custom-defs/customDropped` reachable.
body.title: Body

customKept.$comment: Reached from main via a JSON pointer into a non-`$defs` container. Transitively keeps `even-more-custom-defs/deepKept`.
customKept.title: Custom kept
customKept.description: A definition in a non-standard container, reached from the root schema.

deep.$comment: Internal ref into ANOTHER non-standard container -> must be rewired and keep `deepKept`.
deep.title: Deep
deep.description: A value defined in an even more custom container.

customDropped.$comment: Only referenced from the dropped body -> shaken away.
customDropped.title: Custom dropped
customDropped.description: A definition nothing reachable refers to.

deepDropped.title: Deep dropped
deepDropped.description: A definition nothing reachable refers to.
